parts.covers: Recorded daily units sold of 5 kg whole wheat atta (ATTA-WW-5KG) in June 2026. Demand and lost sales (shoppers who wanted but did not buy) are not recorded; this plan provides only the sales evidence.

parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and daily sales.date between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by daily sales.date; report date = daily sales.date, units_sold = sum of daily sales.units_sold; sorted by date asc.
